name: DJI Mini 3 Pro / Mini 4 Pro motors (set of 4)

mass.reference: About 6 g a motor, from teardowns of similar sub-250 g drones

thrust.reference: About 190 g of thrust a motor at full throttle on 2S with 6-inch propellers

current.reference: Full-throttle draw a motor on 2S; DJI doesn't publish it

efficiency.reference: Rotor figure of merit of about 0.55 times about 0.65 for motor and ESC; large, slow plastic propellers at this size
